test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 50 days. If A is 40% less efficient than B, in how many days can A working alone complete 60% of the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can do a piece of work in 50 days.

A is 40% less efficient than B

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the workers × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of B be 5a

So, efficiency of A = 5a × 60%

⇒ 3a

So, total efficiency of them = 8a

Total work = 8a × 50
